spine.active_goal: Find why the Meadow page loads and changes time of day slowly on Windows (and freezes after several time changes plus a full-screen toggle), why it loads slowly on Android, and why the onboarding Meadow animation is slow and choppy on every platform; fix each cause without changing how either looks (quality included), test on the owner's Windows PC with a heavily seeded journal, and ship through the pipeline as draft PRs.
spine.next_step: Before the owner merges PR 308, re-measure Windows 10.12 on the owner's PC (once it renders Calendar frames near 8 ms again) and the Android emulator 10.13 (once the Note10+ is off the Mac's shared adb) on builds of aa8852d1, recording results in ~/.mitosis/field-notes/meadow-snapshot-pacing/review/device/aa8852d1.md; then close the thread if c1 to c3 hold.
